featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely love ordering from her!! it’s become a yearly ritual for us! Every single cake has been consistently amazing, both in flavour and presentation.

The attention to detail, quality of ingredients, and perfect balance of flavours really stand out. Even flavours you’re unsure about end up being crowd favourites..that’s how good the baking is.

She’s incredibly reliable, warm, and easy to coordinate with, which makes every celebration stress-free and special. Would 100% recommend her to anyone looking for delicious, beautifully made cakes. Always a hit!

featured_reviews.name: priyanka jambhule
featured_reviews.review_text: We absolutely loved the cake! The way you understood the story behind our theme and brought it to life so beautifully was heartwarming. The 3D figurines were adorable and the cake tasted amazing — everyone enjoyed it. Thank you so much for taking a last-minute request and still putting so much love and creativity into it. You made our celebration unforgettable!

featured_reviews.name: Sharayu Sardesai
featured_reviews.review_text:
The cake was absolutely fabulous! 🍰

Just the other day I was telling my husband how I was craving a good Black Forest cake 🥹 and this one truly hit the spot!

Not only did it taste divine, but I honestly couldn’t believe how gorgeous it looked 🤩. It was so beautiful that I hesitated to even cut it 🙈. At the party, I secretly hoped people would pick other desserts from the restaurant menu so I could keep more cake for myself… but everyone loved it so much that they went for seconds (and even packed some for their kids!) 😫

Thank you so much for baking this for me — it’s hands down the best-looking (and best-tasting) cake I’ve had! 🫶🏻💜🤗

featured_reviews.name: Ritika Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: I have got my wedding cake baked by Shaily & it was the absolute highlight of my function. Give her a photo of what you want & she will make it come to life. The best cake I’ve had. Recently got 4 bento cakes made by her for my husband’s birthday & she did a fantastic job of not just making exactly what I want but absolutely nailing the taste of every flavour. Her cakes are always the highlight of the party. Can’t stop recommending her. Total delight to work with & super talented 👏🏼🥰

featured_reviews.name: Arshi Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an excellent first time experience with The Next Door Baker. The custome cake was well executed and the flavour was TOOO good!! We went with the Belgium chocolate with salted caramel. Cannot wait to try all the flavours. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Zenia Merchant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered the pistachio-strawberry cake From The Next Door Baker for my mother-in-law’s 60th birthday, and it was absolutely yummilicious!
The texture was soft, moist and melt-in-the-mouth, and the cake looked as stunning as it tasted.

Thank You Shaily ❤️
Our entire family loved it, and it truly made the celebration extra special. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a unique and delicious cake! 💚🍓🎂

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Patni
featured_reviews.review_text:
All the desserts were super delicious. Couldn't even resist for a bit as soon as I received them. Was craving for lemon blueberry cake since I was expecting and got to try it now and it's was worth every single bite💕

I was never a sweet tooth person and yet wanted to give a shot to a few flavours and I am drooled over them😋

featured_reviews.name: Amrita Engineer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shaily Sanghvi you are the rockstar 😍❣️
The best baker creating yummiest cakes in Mumbai for sure.
It was my 100k on Instagram celebration cake and it was an extremely special moment for me more so coz i was celebrating it in my offline global certification event with 60+ students.
The cake came on stage, everyone went WOOOOWWWW looking at it anddddd we all polished off 3 kgs cake in straight 10 minutes 😂😂😂😂😍
it was that yummy, light, classic chocolate flavour and best quality ingredients.

Thank you Shaily ❤️
You are the best. 🫶
Love,
Amrita Kunal

featured_reviews.name: Keval Gemani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience. I ordered a Chocolate Box and a Brownie Box from Theobroma, and both boxes arrived filled with dead red ants. Not a few — the desserts were literally infested.

This is disgusting and dangerous, showing a complete lack of hygiene and quality control. For a brand that claims to be premium, this is shocking negligence. I can’t imagine how such items were even allowed to leave their kitchen.

Yes, they refunded the order after I complained — but no amount of money erases the horror of opening a dessert box crawling with ants. A refund doesn’t fix a broken hygiene system.

This incident has completely destroyed my trust in Theobroma. I won’t be ordering again, and I’d strongly urge the brand to take serious action to ensure such contamination never happens again.

Utterly disappointed, disgusted, and furious.

featured_reviews.review_text: Small congested store with the worst staff possible. I would like to narrate an incident today in the store. featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointed with the Final Cake

We had ordered a racing car-themed birthday cake (as shown in the second image), which was vibrant, detailed, and full of character – complete with multiple recognizable cars, a smooth spiral road design, and clean, professional decoration.

Unfortunately, the cake that was delivered (first image) was quite underwhelming in comparison. It was lacking the spiral road and many of the detailed elements shown in the reference. The cars used were generic and fewer in number, the road design was basic, and overall decoration looked rushed and amateurish. The grass detailing was clumpy, and the balloons and traffic lights looked like a quick afterthought.

We were especially disappointed because this was meant for a child’s special day, and the original design had really excited them. While the basic theme was there, the execution fell far short of expectations. If you're looking for a truly custom and polished cake, I would advise double-checking with the baker or considering other options.

featured_reviews.name: Aamna Quraishii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Got their croissants and chocolate eclairs for some weekend indulgence, and what a pleasantly unexpected surprise this has been!
The butter croissant is flaky, buttery deliciousness. The chocolate croissant is all that plus the most scrumptious, mouth watering chocolate filling!

Don’t be fooled by soft, bready looking packs in store. Take them home and warm in a hot oven for 2-3 mins; leave to cool and they will be the best croissants you will have bought at a bakery in the city. Crispy on the outside with those layers and a good bite inside!

The eclair was polished off with no time for a photo but again, delicious chocolate coating and cream filling, soft base which can be warmed and crisped on a pan if you like it toasted.

Portions are massive and well priced.

I bought the croissants end of day on a Friday and they tasted fresh through the weekend stored at room temp; eclair in the fridge.

Quick billing at the late hour but they do get very busy during peak.
Their cookies and palmiers are legendary; looking forward to trying other pastries and tiramisu soon!
